msg: So without making this too complicated:There are 2 forests. The bright forest with a red basket which you get to my choosing the red, blue, green or orange gnomes. The dark forest with a yellow basket which you get to by choosing the yellow, brown, pink or purple gnomes.During each round (and I suspect possibly mid-round) the forest containing the most mushroom changes. so if initially your red basket was getting more mushrooms but suddenly starts getting 0, try the other forest and see if it has changed. If you pay attention then this becomes easier.bright forest/red basket: red, blue, green & orange gnomesdark forest/yellow basket: yellow, brown, pink & purple gnomesyou want to try and get the most mushrooms as you can. for the most part the forest was mostly consistent per round but there was once or twice that it changed mid round for me so just stay focused and you will be fine!! GOOD LUCK!!P.S. the position/hats/size of gnome doesn't make any difference, you're looking at the colour of the gnomes. you will get one bright forest gnome and one dark forest gnome on the screen at a time.
